_comment_mode: Only 'dry_run' is implemented by dry_run_report.py. There is no enforcing/write code path in this deployment at all -- changing this value to anything else makes the service refuse to start. Building an enforcing mode is a deliberate future decision for the owner, not a flag flip.
_comment_interval: 300s = one measurement cycle every 5 minutes. Each cycle is a handful of read-only SELECTs against wiki.db plus a couple of small writes to invariants.db's own tables.
